firstPlayerRule: The most easily contented player goes first.
houseFallback: If this criterion does not suit your group, agree to choose randomly. This is a house rule.
clarifications: The starter draws five cards. The remaining players, in clockwise order, draw six, seven and eight cards as applicable.
interpretation: Here, the German word genügsamste means being content with little. The rule gives no objective test.
